I’ve missed returning phone calls, and bills get left under piles of mail. I’ve forgotten errands I told my daughter I’d do. I mean, I know where I am. The day can slip by on me, but I’m not… lost like that.\n\nDoctor: Does this feel like a change from how organized and forgetful you used to be?\n\nPatient: Yes… it does. I had to step away from leading a big event at the senior center, which was embarrassing. And my daughter’s been checking over my bills and appointments now… she doesn’t really trust me to keep it all straight by myself anymore.\n\nDoctor: Have you been feeling sad most days?\n\nPatient: I don’t think I’d say sad most days. I have quiet days, and I get frustrated… but sad, I’m not sure.\n\nDoctor: Even when you’re having a relatively calm day, do you still have the same trouble keeping track of things?\n\nPatient: Yes… even on calm days.
